speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a pediatric patient with a 3-week history of fatigue, fever, easy bruising, and severe leg pain. To understand the severity of your leg pain, can you describe if it is worse when you walk or rest?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Leukemia (likely ALL). The combination of prolonged fatigue, easy bruising (thrombocytopenia), fever (neutropenia/infection), and severe nocturnal leg pain (bone marrow expansion) in a 4-year-old is highly suggestive of leukemia until proven otherwise. Immediate blood work including CBC with differential and peripheral smear is required. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count_With_Differential.
